class.name: NetwInterestHandle
class.brief_description: The [NetwInterestLayer] layers an entity is in, and callbacks for when peers start or stop seeing it.
class.description:
Get it from [method Netw.configure_interest] or [member NetwEntity.interest]. Every method returns the handle, so calls can be chained. It is safe to call in [method Object._init], before the node is in a session. The server applies the layers, and clients keep them for their own callbacks. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_interest(self) \ .join(&"team:red", NetwMultiplayer.LEAVE_POLICY_RETAIN) \ .join(&"sight") \ .on_enter(_on_interest_enter)
# later Netw.configure_entity(self).interest.join(&"team:blue") [/codeblock]

method.name: entity
method.description: Returns the [NetwEntity], or [code]null[/code] once it is gone.

method.name: join
method.description: Adds the entity to the layer [param layer_id]. [param leave_policy] and [param perception_policy] set what happens when a peer stops seeing it through this layer. [code]-1[/code] keeps the current setting. Use [method on_leave_policy] and [method on_perception_policy] for the custom policies.

method.name: layer_ids
method.description: Returns a copy of the layer names the entity joined.

method.name: leave
method.description: Removes the entity from the layer [param layer_id].

method.name: of
method.description: Same as [method Netw.configure_interest]. Returns [code]null[/code] and pushes an error when [param node] is not an entity root.

method.name: on_enter
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(layer_id, peer_id)[/code] when a peer starts seeing the entity through [param layer_id]. An empty [param layer_id] means every layer joined so far.

method.name: on_leave
method.description: Calls [param callback] as [code]callback(layer_id, peer_id)[/code] when a peer stops seeing the entity through [param layer_id]. An empty [param layer_id] means every layer joined so far.

method.name: on_leave_policy
method.description: Sets what happens to a peer's copy when it stops seeing the entity through [param layer_id]. [constant NetwMultiplayer.LEAVE_POLICY_CUSTOM] requires [param custom_callback], called on the server as [code]custom_callback(peer_id, layer_id)[/code].

method.name: on_perception_policy
method.description: Sets whether this peer keeps showing the entity when it stops seeing it through [param layer_id]. [constant NetwMultiplayer.PERCEPTION_POLICY_CUSTOM] requires [param custom_callback], called as [code]custom_callback(visible, peer_id, layer_id)[/code].
